name: GetCurrentDateTimeNode
label: Get Current Date and Time
description: This activity retrieves the current date and time based on the specified retrieval type and time zone.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: RetrieveType
fields.label: Retrieve Type
fields.description: Select the type of datetime information to retrieve (e.g., Current date and time, Current date only).

selectOptions.label: Current Date and Time
selectOptions.description: Retrieves the current date and time.

fields.name: TimezoneType
fields.label: Time Zone
fields.description: Select the time zone to use for retrieving the datetime (e.g., System time zone, Windows time zone).

selectOptions.label: System Time Zone
selectOptions.description: Uses the system's local time zone.

selectOptions.label: Specific Time Zone
selectOptions.description: Uses a specific time zone (to be deprecated).

selectOptions.label: Windows Time Zone
selectOptions.description: Uses the Windows time zone settings.

selectOptions.label: Custom Input
selectOptions.description: Allows custom input for the time zone.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: The retrieved date and time based on the specified options.
